proposed_facts.reason: Independently verified the owned UNK_T[2] definition, VsApproachData's two u8 fields, shared scene-data registration, ChallengerData field producer and signed-byte consumer. The contextual extern declaration also confirms the declaration mismatch. The proposal correctly resolves payload semantics while explicitly deferring allocation size and section placement; functionality.md preserves the same distinction.

The counter is u16, initialized to zero, and post-incremented before short-circuiting controller access on old values below 180. Invocation 181 is first eligible, and wraparound creates another 180-invocation lockout if the scene persists. The canonical callee writes state 1; the loop distinguishes state 2. No local timeout or acknowledgement latch exists. The document and proposal agree without relying on the rendered exit-request name.

Accepted deferral of the five .data facts and link:77ba08e1-e3b8-40ea-80e0-6fe32a540e3b. Canonical code establishes resource strings, fighter-to-frame mapping, whitelist and fallback, but not .data ownership or emitted dispatch metadata. The silhouette/portrait attribution also requires asset evidence. Source-level behavior is retained rather than discarded with the unsupported section attribution.

Accepted deferral of the four .sdata2 facts: integer animation arguments and explicit zero values establish behavior, not conversion-bias constants, shared storage, pool size, alignment, padding or section references. No compiled evidence was supplied to resolve those claims.

Accepted supersession of fact:242849b6-415b-487e-9748-553445ce36b1. Payload purpose is not entirely unresolved: registration and producer establish challenger kind and human slot. The UNK_T array definition conflicts with the typed extern declaration, so the proposal appropriately leaves declaration reconciliation and compiled storage unresolved.

Accepted supersession of fact:82a0e0cc-682d-4a56-abfd-a2e6c5fd4fa7. Permanent eligibility after the initial threshold would contradict the unsaturated u16 postincrement. The correction preserves both periodic wraparound lockout and numeric state 1 without conflating it with state 2 or a direct unlock operation.
